name: harsha-music-bot
description: Harsha - Feature-rich Discord Music Bot with slash commands, interactive button UI controls, queue management, and ad-free multi-platform yt-dlp audio streaming.

scripts.build: npm install --ignore-scripts && npm rebuild @discordjs/opus sodium-native ffmpeg-static
scripts.start: curl -L https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/releases/latest/download/yt-dlp_linux -o ./yt-dlp && chmod +x ./yt-dlp && node src/deploy-commands.js && node src/index.js
